structural.summary: All 203 current files were inventoried; required Phase 17 artifacts were present; JSON, non-template YAML and TOML parsed; and unresolved forbidden tokens were absent.

phase17StaticContracts.summary: Migration/RLS, immutable plan and root catalog methods, exact-key workers, manifest/root publication ordering, operator barriers, reference handoff, REST schemas, and Helm responsibility wiring were present.

cargoFormatClippyTest.reason: cargo, rustc and rustfmt are unavailable and the repository lacks the dependency-resolved Cargo.lock required for a locked production build.

postgresObjectStoreIntegration.reason: No PostgreSQL 16 and S3-compatible immutable-object integration environment is available.
postgresObjectStoreIntegration.requiredEvidence: Migration 4, forced RLS, immutable retry CAS, partial upload, checksum corruption, manifest-last, root-last, and catalog restart tests.

helmRke2Autoscaling.reason: helm, kubectl, RKE2, Kueue, Rancher Cluster Autoscaler, custom metrics, and responsibility machine pools are unavailable.

referenceAndArtifactEquivalence.reason: The pinned Rust toolchain, HermiT adapter, Java runtime, Parquet inspectors, PostgreSQL, and object storage are unavailable.
referenceAndArtifactEquivalence.requiredEvidence: Forward/reverse/retry artifacts plus one-node/N-node root, reference snapshot, certified-query multiset, and GUID hydration equality.

faultInjection.reason: A supported multi-node cluster is required to kill planner, artifact, finalizer, operator, catalog, object-store, and reasoner components at each publication boundary.

endToEnd.reason: Phase 17 implements the durable service path but cannot claim a working deployment until all external compile, database, object-store, reasoner, Helm, RKE2, query, and hydration gates pass.
